tei:div.tei:p: bod du bstan pa phyi dar dang*/ mkhas grub sdai dgon byung tshul bzhugs so/ /

e ma ho/ chos rgyal 'ami dpon klames dbonablumakhyen brtse'i nam mkha' la/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma bod kyi yul du gsal/ /sdig chen dar ma'i dgra chen gdong pa yis/ /chu mo phag nas drug cu rtsa brgyad bar/ /mun pa'i rgyal khams bzhin du nag por sgrib/bod khams phala'aphyer klacherablubastan pa'i sgra mi grags/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad gab dang bros 'gros btsol/ /dbus gtsang mthil du chos min sna tshogs dar/ /rgyal khrims chen po'ang rang gi spyod par thal/ /de la rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bzod par/ /mnga' bdag tsha la na yi thugs rgyud bskul/ /bla chen spyan sngar chos zhu rim par brdzangs/ /bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang tshul dang*/ /phyi dar rgyas pa byung tshul 'di ltar 'ganang klasnangablu/ zha lu bu ston chos rje'i chos 'byung la/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs 'dir/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa phyi dar byung tshul ni/ sdig rgyal glang dar mar grags pa de nyid/ chu mo lug lo sum cu so dgu lon pa'i dus/ mnga' bdag khri ral grongs nas/ khong gis rgyal srid bzung*/ lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin sgrub/ chu mo phag gi lo gzhug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang*/ blon po rgyal to re stag sna can la sogs pa sdig pa la dga' ba rnams kyis sgyur nas/ sngar nu bu la rgyal srid bskaus pa'i snying nad du byas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snub/ lo phyed dang bzhir sdig rgyal kho na byas/ zhe bzhi lon pa me pho stag gi lo'i dus/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes/ lha sa'i rdo ring rtsa ru glang dar ma bkrongs so/ /de'i dus su 'jad kyis gyil mi gtsang rab bsal dang*/ bod gdong pa g.yo dge byung*/ stod lung ba/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum po/ dpal chu bo ri la sgom zhing yod pas na btsun pas khyi ra byed pa mthong te/ dris pas rgyal po'i bstan pa snub par shes te/ 'dul ba'i po ti drel khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris stod du braus/

gar log la lam byas nas hor yul du phyin la/ chos dar bar bya snyam pa la/ skad rigs mi gcig lo ts+tsha med pas dar bar ma nus te | mdo smad lho dngos kyi be ra tsha ma tsho na tshur byung nas/ rga lung rdo rje grags ra | an byung rnam rdzong/ dan tig shel kyi yang dgon du sleb/ sgom zhing yod pa la | rma chu kha'i phyugs rdzi'i mthong nas yul mi la smras pa/ bon po'i grub thob/ mu zu gsal bzang bya ba'i bu lo bco lnga lon pa/ las dang skal ba ldan zhing mos pa la spyod pa'i/ dpal mu zu gsal 'bar gyi tshor nas/ ltar phyin pas mthong ba tsam gyi dad nas/ rab tu byung ba zhus pa la/ 'dul ba'i slab bya'i po ti bstan nas/ 'di la ltos/ 'di ltar rab tu byung na gsungs/ ltas pas shin du dad te mchi ma byung ngo*/ /der gtsang gi mkhan po/ g.yos slob dpon byas nas rab tu byung dge tshul gyi ming*/ mkhan slob dang sbyar nas dge ba rab gsal du btags so/ /phyis thugs rab phye 'aklacheblubs/ dgongs pa rab gsal du grags so/ /de nas lo 'ga' song pa dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs zhus dus/ dge slong lnga ma tshang bas mi yong gsungs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje na re/ nges rgyal po bsad pas byar mi rung gzhan nas btsal gyis rgya nag ha shang ke wang dang | gyi ban bya ba btang byung ba dang*/ mkhan slob dang dmar kyi gsang ston/ rgya'i dge slong gnyis pos kha skong byas te lnga tshogs kyi bsnyen rdzogs byas so// de nas lo lnga lon pa dang*/ bsam yas na yum brtan gyi rgyal rgyud/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras kyis/ mdo smad na rab byung yod pa'i rgyu mtshan tshor nas | dbus gtsang gi mi shes rab dang snying rus che rnams/ chos 'tshol ba la nges par btang dgos dgongs par shar te/ dbus nas blags pa lam pa/ klu mes shes rab tshul khrims dang*/ 'bre ye shes yon tan/ rab shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/

gtsang nas | mgur mo rab kha ba/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyugashab sgo mnga' ba'i tshong btsun she rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'od rgyal spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa lde dkar ba dang lnga stai/ mi bcu po de khams la brdzangs nas/ gtsang g.yo dmar gsum la/ bka' drin zhus pas/ gtsang na re nged rgas pas mkhan po mi 'khyong | bla ma chen po la zhus gsungs/ bla chen gyi bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ lo lnga las ma lon pas na/ mkhan po mi gtub ze ba la/ gtsang na re dmigs bsal la gtub pas gyis gsung nas/ bla chen gyi mkhan po/ gtsang g.yos las slob dang gsang ston byas/ dmar dang ha shang 'gi klagisablukha skong byas te | thams cad chig rdzogs par byas so/ /de nas bla chen gyi zhal nas da khyed rnams yar song 'alesaklalablu/ dbus gtsang du bstan pa dar ba gcig gal che'o/ /de'ang lo ston mthu che bas bstan bsrung gyis/ klu mes sku btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong gas blo 'asno klarnoblubs ston pa gyis/ 'bre khas bkod mkhas pas gnas gzhi zung gsungs nas byin po yar yong*/ klu mes kyi gnubs ye shes rgyal mtshan la 'dul ba nyan cing bsdad do/ /de nas yar yong pa rnams kyi/ ldan klong thang du slebs dus/ lo ston na re/ khyed tsho 'di khar sdod cigangs dbus gtsang du phyin la bstan pa dar nus mi nus brtag stai/ nus na bsdad kyi mi nus na nga yang log yong gis gsungs nas/ ldan mi tshong pa dang 'graugs te yar byon/ de'i phyi lo klu mes 'akyi klakyis blukyang*/ slob dpon la zhus nas yar byon pa dang*/ lo ston gyi khong rnams la bsu ba la byon pas/ thams cad dbus su 'dzoms nas/ yar byon pa dang*/ bsam yas su mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras dang mjal lo/ /sdig rgyal glang dar mas chu mo phag nas bstan pa bsnubs/ khong rang gi lo mang ma thub kyang*/ de'i smon lam log pa dang*/ las ngan shugs ches pas/ lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la/ bstan pa'i ming med pa'i dus su/

dbus gtsang gnyis gyi mi bcu po bsam yas su slebs | rgyal pos bkur sti dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs te/ nyin mo ltar gsal zhing*/ dar rgyas che bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos bka' gnang*/ khong rnams gros mthun par dbus gtsang gi sa char/ rten lha khang bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sdai 'dzugs par chad bsdams te/ klu mes kyis/ sngar sor la mo phyag de'u brtsigs/ gzhu kun dga' ra ba dang*/ tsha mig brtsigs/ 'dre ngan lam spyi lo dang*/ snyan thang brag sna brang ra mo che brtsigs/ sbas kyi gzhung nya mo gyur dang*/ lan pa spyil bu brtsigs/ rag shi'i 'phrang po lha khang dang*/ sum pas 'gro swa thang dang*/ rme ru brtsigs/ khong rnams kyi slaub ma yang slob dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs so/ /gtsang du los ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong brtsigs/ rgya shākya gzhon nu dang*/ 'gos g.yag srung la sogs pa bu chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung*/ a mes tshong btsun shes rab seng ges/ rtsigs gyi yang dben brtsigs/ zhang ston mtshal 'phags la sogs/ slob ma yang mang dag byung bas/ de rnams kyi dge 'dun gyi sde lha khang tshan che ba bzhengs/ mgo g.yag gi slob ma/ lce btsun sher 'byung gis zha lu 'a mo bzhengs/ de ltar khams su dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'i phyin kyang*/ sum pa dang 'o rgyang spun la mched pa med cing*/ 'a 'dre gnyis de rnams la mar gtogs zer ro/ /a mes bla ma chen mo dang*/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu po dang bcas pa de rnams/ bod kha ba can pa la shin tu nas kyang sku drin che'o/ /der rting bod rgyal 'od srung rgyud/ lha bla ma ye shes khu dbon rnams kyi rje btsun gha ya dha ra dang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha pha dam pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la sogs/ rgya bal gyi lo paṇa mang po gdan drangs pa dang*/ bod yul du 'khrungs pa'i bla ma sa skya khu dbon/

lo chen rin bzang*/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ dgas po dang shang pa bka' rgyud pa la sogs/ lo paṇa mkhas grub bzang la mang ba/ rim par byon pa rnams bshad nyan sgom sgrub kyis bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pas/ bstan pa rin po che gangs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu gsal zhing dngas par bzhugs pa lags so/ /bstan pa phyi dar dar tshul 'di bris pas/ /bstan chu rgyun rgyun ring kladubluganas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes mchog mchog tu yar 'phel nas/ /bstan zhugs 'gro kun kun mkhyen thob par shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/bstan pa phyi dar dang mkhas grub sde dgon byung tshul/ -PAGE 246--PAGE 245-
